summary: Test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly with awaited assertions; however, the selector used seems weak or generic and does not clearly verify product cards visibility on the home page. The test title preserves the testCaseId. No issues with asynchronous usage or Locator handling found.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="nav-home"]' is ambiguous and does not clearly target product cards on the home page as intended. It may point to a navigation element instead of the product card grid.
issues.recommendation: Use a more specific and descriptive selector that directly targets the product card grid element to better align with the test purpose.

issues.description: The assertion only checks visibility of a single element and does not verify that product cards themselves are visible or contain expected content such as images or prices.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions that specifically verify content within the product cards to improve test coverage and reliability.

recommendations: Improve selector specificity for product cards verification.
Enhance assertions to confirm actual product card content and layout visibility.
